```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!-- internal parameter entity comment -->">
  <!ENTITY ent-ref "resolved entity value">
  %ent;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising parser comment state -->
  <sub:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup-like text: <child>&ent-ref;</child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author "Jane Doe">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY pub 'Acme Publishing'>">
  %pe;
]>
<?pi-target processing instruction data with &author; reference?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment before CDATA section -->
  <book xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Book published by &pub; authored by &author;.
    ]]>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "http://example.com/external.ent">
  <!ENTITY local-ent "Local Entity Text">
  %ext;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml"?>
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://example.org/math">
  <!-- Comment section detailing mathematical extension namespace -->
  <m:section>
    <![CDATA[
      Math content &local-ent; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </m:section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY icon SYSTEM "icon.png" NDATA png>
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY bundle "Bundle Entity">
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose" mode="test"?>
<archive xmlns="http://schema.example.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment preceding the primary item list with entities and CDATA -->
  <item xlink:href="urn:item:1">
    <![CDATA[
      Data segment using &bundle; and checking parser limits.
    ]]>
  </item>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % macro "<!ENTITY nested 'Nested & Deep Entity'>">
  %macro;
  <!ENTITY base "&nested; extension">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.example.com" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment highlighting entity usage and namespace interaction -->
  <stock>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw inventory record: &base;
    ]]>
  </stock>
</inventory>
```
